title: TSS Assignment Schema
description: Binds a Role or Responsibility to the Steward(s) or Delegate(s) who hold it, under a named delegation model. Added v1.2.0. Defined by TSS v1.2.0 §5.12.

role_id.description: References the Role or Responsibility this Assignment binds.

sub_role.description: Meaningful only relative to `model` — e.g. 'responsible'/'accountable'/'consulted'/'informed' under RACI, 'driver'/'approver'/'contributor'/'informed' under DACI, 'manager'/'owner'/'consulted'/'helper'/'approver' under MOCHA. Omit for 'unstructured'.

model.description: The delegation model this Assignment uses. Implementations MAY define additional values; per TSS-CONF-05 a ConformanceClaim using a non-listed model SHOULD declare it as a deviation.

context_id.description: The Context this Assignment is scoped to.
